steps.sql: SELECT "t0"."companyid" AS "companyindustry__companyid", "t0"."classificationid" AS "companyindustry__classificationid", "t0"."created_at" AS "companyindustry__created_at", "t0"."_version" AS "companyindustry___version", "t1"."classificationid" AS "industryclassification__classificationid", "t1"."name" AS "industryclassification__name", "t1"."isprimary" AS "industryclassification__isprimary", "t1"."confidence" AS "industryclassification__confidence", "t1"."created_at" AS "industryclassification__created_at", "t1"."_version" AS "industryclassification___version" FROM "public"."companyindustry" AS "t0" JOIN "public"."industryclassification" AS "t1" ON "t0"."classificationid" = "t1"."classificationid" LIMIT 1000
